themes.summary: SpaceX priced its IPO Thursday and raised $75b (bull case scenarios cited up to $85b), began trading Friday on Nasdaq (SPCX), 24 years after founding. Bull case: Starlink direct-to-cell + AI compute sales to Anthropic/Google (~$2b/mo combined) could support a $1.75t valuation at $200b revenue. Bear case: Starship unproven, compute is commoditizing, and Musk is a keyman risk.

themes.theme: OpenAI and Anthropic both moving toward IPOs
themes.summary: OpenAI filed confidential S-1 papers (Tue) and may cut token prices to compete with Anthropic (Thu BFD), risking a subsidized pricing war just as both prep public listings — unusual timing since IPOs typically follow margin expansion, not compression.

themes.theme: AI infra financing goes mega-scale via private credit/PE
themes.summary: Apollo/Blackstone/Broadcom launched an AI infra platform backed by an initial $35b loan (Wed BFD) to help Anthropic lease Google chips off-balance-sheet via Fluidstack (20+ GW capacity through 2028); KKR followed one day later with its own $10b Helix Digital Infrastructure platform (w/ Kuwait Investment Authority, Nvidia, Vistra, ex-AWS CEO Adam Selipsky at the helm).

Prometheus, the industrial 'artificial general engineer' AI startup led by Jeff Bezos and ex-Google exec Vik Bajaj, raised $12b Series B at a $41b post-money valuation (JPMorgan, BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, DST Global, Arch Venture Partners) — aims to compress physical-product design/manufacturing cycle times, not to automate factories/robotics per se.

Flutter Entertainment (FanDuel/Betfair parent) disclosed plans to fully delist from the London Stock Exchange, following CRH (April) and Wise (May) moving primary listings to New York — the latest sign of London's competitiveness crisis for corporate listings.

themes.theme: DCC bidding war resolves in a week
themes.summary: KKR/Energy Capital Partners' takeover bid for Irish energy distributor DCC escalated from a rejected £4.95b approach, to a sweetened >£5b offer (Wed), to an accepted £5.7b deal (Thu) — a rapid full-week price arc captured within a single Pro Rata week.
